messages.content: Write a polished short scene in modern American English that reaches a natural stopping point after a small everyday interaction. Do not summarize the lesson of the scene, the importance of the relationship, or what the characters have learned. End with a simple action, line, or image that feels earned by what happened.

Alex picked up the empty coffee mug.

“You want another?”

Jordan shook her head. “No.”

“You sure?”

“Yeah. I'm good.”

Alex carried the mug to the sink and turned on the water.

Jordan watched her for a second.

“What?” Alex asked.

“Nothing.”

“That wasn't a nothing look.”

Jordan smiled. “I'm just thinking.”

“Dangerous.”

“I know.”

Alex rinsed the mug and set it in the rack.

Jordan stood and grabbed her bag.

“You leaving?”

“Eventually.”

Alex laughed. “That's not how leaving works.”

Jordan slipped the bag over her shoulder.

“Watch me.”

She made it three steps toward the door before turning around.

“I forgot my phone.”

Alex held it up from the counter.

Jordan sighed. “Of course you did.”

“Eventually,” Alex said.

Jordan took the phone and laughed.
